title: Other Important Dockerfile Instructions knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Other Important Dockerfile Instructions”?
options: Publish every service on all host interfaces by default.
Assume container IP addresses never change.
Use host networking to gain stronger network isolation.
Choose the network driver and published ports to match the required communication boundary.
questions.answer_key: Choose the network driver and published ports to match the required communication boundary.
questions.explanation: Network drivers have distinct isolation and connectivity behavior; user-defined bridge networks support name-based communication on a host.

questions.prompt: For a lab covering other important dockerfile instructions, what is the strongest evidence of learning?
options: Make several unrelated changes before collecting a baseline.
Use a production host so the result looks realistic.
Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
Assume the command is portable and skip reading its output.
questions.answer_key: Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.explanation: A useful lab connects a predicted result to actual output and checks an edge case. This is safer and more reproducible than assuming success.

questions.prompt: If an example related to other important dockerfile instructions fails, which response is best?
options: Trust the image tag without inspecting the image or version.
Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
Delete every stopped container and unused volume before investigating.
Disable permissions or security controls until the example works.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
questions.explanation: The evidence-led approach keeps the diagnosis reproducible and avoids hiding the cause. For other important dockerfile instructions, verify the fix with the exact setting or command that failed.
